scenario.title: Metsovo Pass
intro.text:
METSOVO PASS - 19 APR 1941

South of Grevena, West Macedonia

After your breakthrough at Lake Kastoria we could not hold open the gap for long time and only a few troops could escaped. You have now the Germans before and behind! A German SS unit, passed Lake Kastoria before, is already on their way to Metsovo pass and there is now the opportunity to attack this force from behind! Prevent the blockade of the Metsovo pass and allow further comrades to escape!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE Due to the short time between the missions at HQ no new units can be recruited!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-7-0-briliant.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.reaction-7-0-briliant.text: The Kastoria road remained usable until the main body passed. German patrols reached the exit after the last organised rear guard had already turned south.
line.reaction-7-1-victory-tactical.text: The required units came through, though the rear guard crossed in fragments. Metsovo will receive the survivors and the arguments about who stayed too long.
line.callback-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-0.text: Dendrochori closed on the minute you ordered, although two captains tried to turn the delay into a last stand. I trust your hours now more than their enthusiasm.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: You shortened the Kastoria position before the road closed. More units reached Metsovo; the troops left on the northern shore had fewer hours bought for them.
line.callback-2.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-2.text: The Trebeshinë reserve remained intact and became the unit everyone called when a road had only one more hour.
line.callback-3.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-3.text: No separate reserve survived the reorganisation, but fewer western battalions arrived at Metsovo as names without strength.
line.scene-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-0.text: Three roadblocks ahead. The first has an antitank gun, the second has felled trees, and the third is known only because every refugee points at it without stopping.
line.scene-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-1.text: One heavy group can batter through in order. Light parties can climb around and take the intersections, but their guns will remain down here with us.
line.decision.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.decision.text: I require a road by nightfall. Which risk do you want entered in the signal: a slow concentration, or light groups beyond artillery support?
line.decision.choice.break-the-roadblock: Form one heavy group and smash through the roadblocks in sequence.
Spend 50 prestige, give infantry and artillery 15 experience, and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.turn-the-intersecti: Send light groups over the ridges to seize the intersections behind the roadblocks.
Give reconnaissance 20 experience and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: Concentration means the third roadblock hears us coming for hours.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-a-1.text: It also means our infantry hears its own guns. Put the engineers in front, displace the batteries after each position, and keep the recovery trucks off the centre of the road.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-b-0.text: If a light group is pinned beyond the ridge, there is no respectable way to rescue it.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: Then give them mortars, wire cutters, and permission to leave any hill that is not a road. They are opening the pass, not conquering the clouds.
